verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's CHKit lets an agent describe, validate, test and deploy schema and pipelines as code in CI, with a reviewable diff. That covers the versioning and review parts of the story. Rollback is not documented for these automations: point-in-time recovery and time travel restore database state, which is a different capability from rolling back an automation or pipeline definition. Missing for 10: documented rollback of deployed pipelines/automations, explicit version history for automations, depth docs on CHKit beyond a marketing line, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: CHKit gives them typed commands to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code: infrastructure an agent can drive, in CI, with a diff you can review.
